h_regions.name: primary genetic report
h_regions.description: Original papers that establish SAT1 as the causal gene for SLEB19 by reporting affected patients and segregating or de novo pathogenic variants.

h_regions.name: follow-up human genetics
h_regions.description: Subsequent patient series, cohort studies, or case reports that mention SAT1-related lupus or include SAT1 among genes screened in early-onset/monogenic SLE.

h_regions.name: functional mechanism study
h_regions.description: Experimental papers that test SAT1 disease variants or SAT1 deficiency in cells or animal models to explain lupus pathogenesis.

h_regions.name: synthetic follow-up evidence
h_regions.description: Papers that do not report new SAT1 patients or direct functional experiments, but synthesize the SAT1-SLEB19 claim in reviews, meta-analyses, guideline-style summaries, or broader monogenic lupus overviews that mention SAT1 in passing.

h_regions.name: variant-level genotype-phenotype expansion
h_regions.description: Human genetics papers that extend the original SAT1 finding by reporting the same or additional SAT1 variants in new affected individuals or families, without being the first causal report.

h_regions.name: direct functional validation
h_regions.description: Experimental studies that functionally test SAT1 disease variants or SAT1 loss in cells or model organisms and explicitly connect the result to lupus-relevant mechanisms.

h_regions.name: computational or informatics synthesis
h_regions.description: Papers that mention SAT1-related lupus in bibliometric analyses, database curation, or text-mined monogenic lupus syntheses, without presenting new patients or bench functional assays.

h_regions.name: post-index citation only
h_regions.description: Later papers that cite the SAT1 lupus paper only as background or contextual evidence, without adding new SAT1 cases or mechanistic experiments.

h_regions.name: nonhuman mechanistic follow-up
h_regions.description: Animal, cell, or molecular studies of SAT1 that are not patient reports but directly test disease-linked mechanisms or perturbations relevant to lupus.

o_regions.description: Clinical genetics papers in PubMed using lupus, early-onset SLE, monogenic lupus, or SAT1 as search anchors.

o_regions.name: Citation network around index paper
o_regions.description: References, citing papers, and similar articles connected to the first SAT1 lupus report.
